start.text: Are you processing (research with) personal data?
start.description: Processing means any operation performed on personal data, whether or not by automated means. This includes collecting, recording, organising, structuring, storing, adapting, retrieving, consulting, using, disclosing, combining, erasing, or destroying personal data.

platform-check.text: Are you using the Next platform by Eyra to conduct your data donation study?
platform-check.note: Note from Niek: this node can likely be removed in the future.

no-dpia.text: No DPIA required. Since you are not processing personal data, a Data Protection Impact Assessment does not apply to your study.

other-platform.text: You are not using the data donation platform that we support. Please check with your organisation what procedures need to be followed for conducting a DPIA.

conduct-dpia.text: You need to conduct a DPIA (Data Protection Impact Assessment) before proceeding with your data donation study. See the sections below for risks to consider and mitigating measures.
